import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def tensor_transpose2D_kernel_(x, shape2D):
    P, F = x.shape
    F1, F2 = shape2D
    assert F1 * F2 == F, f"shape2D {shape2D} does not match the free size {F}"
    
    # Allocate output buffer in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray((P, F), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    # Allocate SBUF for input and output tiles
    sbuf_in = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    sbuf_out = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    # DMA copy input to SBUF
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf_in, src=x)
    
    # Transpose using tile-wise operations
    for p in nl.affine_range(P):
        for i in nl.affine_range(F1):
            for j in nl.affine_range(F2):
                sbuf_out[j, i] = sbuf_in[i, j]
    
    # DMA copy result from SBUF to output
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=out, src=sbuf_out)
    return out
